errors.name: BookNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested book is not found in the library system by its book_id.

errors.name: MemberNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested member is not found in the system by their member_id.

errors.name: BorrowRecordNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a borrow record is not found in the system by its borrow_id.

errors.name: BookAlreadyBorrowedError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to borrow a book that is already currently borrowed by another member.

errors.name: InvalidReturnDateError
errors.description: Raised when a return date is set to a date earlier than the borrow date, which is invalid.
